parents.subject: Agricultural Leadership, Education, and Communications Program
parents.course: Digitizing Development – Teaching and Training Online

ns2:section.sectionText: This course consists of a blended format, with most course content consumed asynchronously online. Students and instructors will meet for 60 minutes each week at the dates and times listed above using Zoom. ALEC 490 is a strict pre-requisite to enroll in this course.
